author: ojiudezue
title: A read-only probe stalled HA: Bermuda diagnostics redact 13 MB on the event loop
summary: Four ha_get_integration include_diagnostics calls on Bermuda each froze the HA event loop about 20 s (02:02-02:04 CST, during an overnight pass in a sleeping house). Byte caps don't help, because HA builds the whole dump before the tool trims it.
why: 'Read-only' is not the same as 'harmless'. Heavy diagnostic endpoints run integration code on the loop. The same answer came from .storage registries and the integration source at no cost.
implications: New memory feedback_no_bermuda_diagnostics_live. Probes check the HA system log after touching heavy endpoints. The incident is recorded on the Bermuda card and the feed.
